description:
# 

Task Description: Problem Statement Takahashi is standing on a two-dimensional plane, facing north. Find the minimum positive integer K such that Takahashi will be at the starting position again after he does the following action K times:

Go one meter in the direction he is facing. Then, turn X degrees counter-clockwise.
Task Constraint: 1 <= X <= 179
X is an integer.
Task Input: Input is given from Standard Input in the following format:
X
Task Output: Print the number of times Takahashi will do the action before he is at the starting position again.
Task Samples: input: 90 output: 4

Takahashi's path is a square.
input: 1 output: 360

## Constraints
1 <= X <= 179
X is an integer.

## Input
Input is given from Standard Input in the following format:
X

## Output
Print the number of times Takahashi will do the action before he is at the starting position again.

## Examples
["input: 90 output: 4\n\nTakahashi's path is a square.", 'input: 1 output: 360']
